reviewNotes: Facts checked against the owner's published portfolio and an authorized October resume. Owner-published means self-reported, not independently verified by an employer. Private source documents, phone numbers, internal systems and metrics are deliberately excluded. Several October resume variants exist; no canonical current download is approved here.

facts.text: Alex builds full-stack applications with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Python and SQL, with experience spanning enterprise applications, healthcare integrations and commerce.
Alex's published work includes React interfaces for Disney, Hoag, McKinsey client work and CHOPT checkout. These are professional experience examples, not public source-code demonstrations.
Alex has built Node.js services, REST APIs and middleware for Disney, Hoag, McKinsey client work and Overpass. His Express work includes routing, CRUD endpoints and Sequelize-backed services.
Alex uses Python for automation, data workflows, Lambda functions, Airflow DAGs and reporting checks.
Alex's documented cloud stack includes AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB and Azure Functions. The portfolio connects this experience to application integrations and automation.

Alex's Hoag experience includes healthcare applications and Epic EHR integrations. His public skills include Cloverleaf, secure APIs, React, Node.js and AWS; confidential patient data and employer source code are not available through this assistant.
Alex's public engineering toolkit includes Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Jest, Cypress, Mocha, DataDog and Sentry, alongside production support and documentation.

Alex describes an AI engineering approach built around APIs, typed schemas, permissions, evaluations, observability, fallbacks and human review. This describes his published approach, not a verified result for an unnamed customer.
Alex's portfolio describes building MCP servers and tool integrations that connect AI clients to APIs and business systems using explicit schemas, authentication and controlled interfaces.
The alext.io repository contains the public portfolio's HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Its homepage is a static, framework-independent implementation rather than a React application.
Realtor Studio is a founder-led product linked from Alex's public portfolio. Its public website is available for review; this knowledge base does not assert unverified revenue or performance results.
Creamed is a founder-led business linked from Alex's public portfolio. It is a public business example, not evidence that every technology discussed by this assistant was deployed there.
Alex's portfolio identifies CHOPT checkout as professional commerce work and describes React checkout interfaces. The public product link is not access to the company's private source code.
Professional opportunities can be discussed directly with Alex through the contact section of alext.io. A meeting has not been booked unless a separate confirmed scheduling process says so.
